        <footnote id="F8">This award was granted on September 25, 2022. 12.5% of the award vested on April 15, 2023 and the remaining RSUs vested 12.5% in semi-annual installments over the four-year period ended October 15, 2026.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F9">This award was granted on October 1, 2023. 12.5% of the award vested on April 15, 2024 and the remaining RSUs vest 12.5% in semi-annual installments over the four-year period ending October 15, 2027, subject to the terms and conditions of the underlying award agreement.</footnote>
